comment: The Change CV jack is dead. process() reads the Change knob into a local at :174, uses it inside the clock branch at :192-199, and only then adds the jack's voltage to that same local at :203, after which the local is never read again; the jack therefore has no effect on anything. The Length knob does not set the loop length, which is what its name and the maker's own module description imply: the shift register is always sixteen bits and always rotates all sixteen, and Length only chooses how many of the top bits are read out as a number and how many of the sixteen lamps are lit. In Poly Ryhtmic mode shift() returns before any mutation, so the Change knob, the Bias knob, the Bias CV and the write switch all do nothing in that mode. The panel carries no lettering on any control: the artwork is a PNG drawn over a blank SVG and prints only the module's name.
